in_hebrew.name: דימיטריוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Greek name Dimitrios, derived from demos (people) and tēros (beloved). In Hebrew, it can be transliterated as דימיטריוס (Dimitrios) and its meaning remains the same: God's follower.

in_greek.name: Δημήτριος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Dimitrios in Greek is derived from demos (people) and tēros (beloved). It means 'Follower of Demos (god)', reflecting the idea of being devoted to a deity or community.

in_latin.name: Dimitrius
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Dimitrios is Dimitrius. Its meaning is 'God's follower'.

biblical_reference.note: In the New Testament, Dimitrios is mentioned twice in the Book of Acts. In the first mention, Paul encounters a certain Dimitrios in Troas and receives a vision from God to go to Macedonia. Later, Paul and Silas are beaten and imprisoned in Philippi, and a prison guard named Dimitrios is converted and becomes part of their mission team.
